title: Dual Blade — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API for jobs + WZ API for Skill/40000.img names)

skills.name: Bandit Slash Boost
skills.description: Boosts Bandit Slash.

skills.name: Tornado Spin
skills.description: Quickly dashes forward to spin attack multiple enemies in your way.\nCan be linked to Blade Ascension.

skills.name: Katara Mastery
skills.description: Enhances Katara Mastery.

skills.name: Bandit Slash Boost
skills.description: Lash out at a group of enemies with crossing blades.

skills.name: Self Haste
skills.description: Permanently increases your Jump, Speed, and Max Speed.

skills.name: Recruit's Agility
skills.description: Gain the ability to Flash Jump upwards.

skills.name: Fatal Blow
skills.description: Deals very quick consecutive attacks to a monster.

skills.name: Slash Storm
skills.description: Attack multiple enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Katara Booster
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Luck.

skills.name: Channel Karma
skills.description: Increase your Attack Power and your ability to resist knockback effects when struck.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases LUK and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Slash Storm Boost
skills.description: Boosts Slash Storm.

skills.name: Flying Assaulter
skills.description: Fly down from the sky to slash nearby enemies, with a chance to stun.\nLinks to Tornado Spin and Bloody Storm.

skills.name: Flashbang
skills.description: Your attacks are empowered by a dazzling flash, permanently increasing your damage.

skills.name: Venom
skills.description: Permanently coats your dagger and katara with venom, giving all your attacks the chance to Poison enemies. Poison is not stackable, and it cannot cause enemies' HP to drop below 1. Also permanently increases Final Damage.

skills.name: Slash Storm Boost
skills.description: Attack multiple enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Bloody Storm
skills.description: Attack enemies on both sides with swift, elaborate movements. Provides passive damage increases for Tornado Spin and Flying Assaulter.\nLinks to Tornado Spin and Flying Assaulter.

skills.name: Blade Ascension
skills.description: The Secret Garden Ascension's secret technique. Rise up into the sky and slash enemies ahead of you.\nBy using this skill with the Up key, you can ascend slightly higher, once per jump. If you ascended from the ground with this command skill, you cannot use it again in the air until after you land.\nLinks to Flying Assaulter. Use is limited after Flash Jumping upward.

skills.name: Chains of Hell
skills.description: Chains of Hell pull an enemy close and deal consecutive Critical strikes with a chance to stun. You will be invincible during this skill's activation and execution, and this skill can also be used while other skills are being used. Stationary monsters must be in range. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Mirror Image
skills.description: Summon a doppelganger of yourself to assist with attacks for a short time. Disappears when it is hit with an attack that changes its appearance or restricts movement. It cannot mimic summoning skills, 5th Job Common Skills, or certain other skills.

skills.name: Advanced Dark Sight
skills.description: Hones your stealth technique, giving you a chance of not breaking Dark Sight when you attack or use skills in Dark Sight. Has a chance to automatically trigger Dark Sight when attacked, and attacking from Dark Sight will increase Final Damage.\nHowever, if you dodge an attack that deals damage proportional to Max HP, using the Dark Sight that activates when you are hit, the cooldown will not apply, and Dark Sight's duration will decrease.

skills.name: Life Drain
skills.description: Grants a chance to recover HP when attacking.\nAlso increases Boss Damage permanently.

skills.name: Enveloping Darkness
skills.description: Cloaks yourself in darkness, increasing Max HP, Abnormal Status Resistance and Elemental Resistance permanently.

skills.name: Shadow Meld
skills.description: Increases your chance to dodge incoming attacks. A successful dodge will also put you into a 7-second frenzy, where your attack power increases and every hit becomes a Critical. Also permanently increases Final Damage and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Blade Fury
skills.description: The secret technique of Secret Garden's tornado. Spin furiously with the two blades in your hands to damage nearby enemies. Ignores a portion of the enemy's defense.

skills.name: Phantom Blow
skills.description: The secret technique of raging Secret Garden. Deals a flurry of piercing attacks against enemies in front of you. Ignores a portion of enemies' defense.

skills.name: Final Cut
skills.description: Deals heavy damage to multiple enemies. Temporarily increases damage.

skills.name: Sudden Raid
skills.description: Call in a horde of friends to attack enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Mirrored Target
skills.description: Turns your Mirror Image into a dummy that draws enemy attacks and absorbs damage. Shadow Meld activates when the dummy is attacked. The enemies focused on the dummy will break free if they don't attack for a certain period of time. This skill can only be used when Mirror Image is active. Permanently increases Blade Master's Defense and Avoidability.

skills.name: Thorns
skills.description: Increases your Attack Power and your ability to resist knockback effects when struck.

skills.name: Sharpness
skills.description: Increases your Critical Rate and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Toxic Venom
skills.description: Increases Venom's poison chance and permanently increases poison damage.

skills.name: Katara Expert
skills.description: Increases Dagger and Katara Mastery, Attack Power, and Final Damage.

skills.name: Blade Fury - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Blady Fury's damage.

skills.name: Blade Fury - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Blade Fury's DEF ignore amount.

skills.name: Blade Fury - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Blade Fury.

skills.name: Phantom Blow - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Phantom Blow damage.

skills.name: Phantom Blow - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Phantom Blow's Monster DEF debuff.

skills.name: Phantom Blow - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases Phantom Blow's attack count.

skills.name: Blade Ascension - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Ignore Defense for Blade Ascension.

skills.name: Blade Ascension - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Blade Ascension.

skills.name: Blade Ascension - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks for Blade Ascension.

skills.name: Asura's Anger
skills.description: Create a vortex of wind blades, damaging nearby enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.

skills.name: Epic Adventure
skills.description: Call upon the bravery deep within to increase damage output.

skills.name: Blade Clone
skills.description: Summons a dagger from the Secret Garden to deal powerful bonus damage with all your attacks. Also increases damage.\nRight-click to lock activation effect.

skills.name: Venom Burst
skills.description: Poison your weapon to deal damage over time to enemies.
skills.note: Thief-common 5th-job skill (Night Lord, Shadower, Dual Blade, Night Walker); passive in GMS 270.

skills.name: Blade Storm
skills.description: Storm forward, slashing enemies with techniques honed at the Secret Garden. You can move while attacking, and are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.

skills.name: Blades of Destiny
skills.description: Decide the fate of your opponents with a blinding flurry of blades. Additional hit from Blade Clone is applied only once.

skills.name: Blade Tornado
skills.description: Spin as fast as a tornado and create a black typhoon that shoots forward to damage your enemies. The typhoon is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Blade Tornado
skills.note: Blade Tornado sub-entry (no description in source).

skills.name: Haunted Edge
skills.description: The malevolent spirit imbued in the blade attacks the enemy on its own. Activates automatically upon using Blade Fury or Phantom Blow.\nUsing Blade Fury in conjunction with this effect will activate Haunted Edge-Asura, which creates a sharp stabbing wind. Using Phantom Blow in conjunction with this effect will activate Haunted Edge-Yaksa, which deals countless consecutive attacks in anger.\nUnaffected by attack reflection. The sharp wind created by Haunted Edge-Asura is unaffected by Mirror Image.

skills.name: Haunted Edge-Asura
skills.note: Haunted Edge-Asura (triggered with Blade Fury).

skills.name: Haunted Edge-Asura
skills.note: Haunted Edge-Asura sub-entry.

skills.name: Haunted Edge-Yaksa
skills.note: Haunted Edge-Yaksa (triggered with Phantom Blow).

skills.name: Last Resort
skills.description: You vow to destroy your enemies at any cost. You can renew your vow to empower its effects by using the skill again while it's active. Using the skill with the down arrow key will immediately renew your vow. With Action Customization enabled, you can renew your vow by pressing its key again, without use of the arrow keys.\nRight-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF
skills.note: Common 5th-job skill, not class-specific.

skills.name: HEXA Phantom Blow
skills.description: The secret technique of raging Secret Garden. Deals a flurry of piercing attacks against enemies in front of you. Ignores a portion of the enemy's defense.

skills.name: HEXA Asura's Anger
skills.description: Create a vortex of wind blades, damaging nearby enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill. Use the skill again to immediately cancel it.

skills.name: HEXA Blade Clone
skills.description: Summons a dagger from the Secret Garden to deal powerful bonus damage with all your attacks. Also increases damage.\nRight-click to lock activation effect.

skills.name: Mortality
skills.description: Yaksha, the god of the netherworld, descends to annihilate all nearby enemies.\nUnaffected by attack reflection

skills.name: HEXA Blade Fury
skills.description:
The secret technique of Secret Garden's tornado. Spin furiously with the two blades in your hands to damage nearby enemies.
Enhances to Fury Jet which periodically does a massive sweep of nearby enemies. With Action Customization enabled, the up arrow key must be used together to trigger Fury Jet.
Also permanently enhances HEXA Phantom Blow.
Right-click to toggle custom commands ON/OFF

skills.name: Fury Jet
skills.description:
The completed secret technique of Secret Garden's tornado. Quickly jab the two blades in your hands to greatly damage nearby enemies.
With Action Customization enabled, the up arrow key must be used together to trigger Fury Jet.
Also permanently enhances HEXA Phantom Blow.
Right-click to toggle custom commands ON/OFF

skills.name: HEXA Sudden Raid
skills.description: Call in a horde of friends to attack enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection.\nAlso permanently enhances Mortality.

skills.name: Karma Blade
skills.description:
The God of Hellfire descends into your sword, transforming it into a Karma Blade. The Karma Blade is consumed with each strike, causing cut enemy to be attacked by their own karma.
When the Karma Blade is completely devoured or its duration ends, the God of Hellfire appears to instantly cut down all life. Targets the enemy with the highest Max HP first and is unaffected by attack reflection.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%

skills.name: Yama's Decree
skills.description:
Pronounces the judgement of just punishment, delivering your enemies to their well-earned execution.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%

Executes enemies in a storm of slashes, as decreed by their just punishment.

notes: Frames listed with placeholder=true are 1x1 timing placeholders in the source WZ data; the player skips them. Placeholder frames are byte-identical across skills and counted once in Unique totals.
Frames shared (byte-identical, 8 frames) between: karma-blade-4361500, karma-blade-4361503.
Frames shared (byte-identical, 7 frames) between: blade-tornado-400041042, blade-tornado-400041043.
Frames shared (byte-identical, 7 frames) between: haunted-edge-asura-400041076, haunted-edge-asura-400041077.
HEXA boost cores (Skill/40000.img 400004xxx) are passive: no effect/hit frames of their own; their visuals are the boosted skill's frames.
V-skill Boost core IDs were not located in the 400004xxx scan; passive cores with no frames, so no visuals are missing.
Venom Burst (400041000) is a thief-common 5th-job skill shared by Night Lord, Shadower, Dual Blade and Night Walker; the duplicate node 400040000 is not included.
Blade Storm also exists as node 400040006 (effect 10 + hit 35 frames, no description, invisible); the described node 400041006 (hit 35 frames) is included here and the duplicate is not.
Last Resort (400041032) is a common 5th-job skill, not class-specific; included once here for completeness.
